paper_id: Video-QTR_ Query-Driven Temporal Reasoning Framework for Lightweight Video Understanding
title: Video-QTR: Query-Driven Temporal Reasoning Framework for Lightweight Video Understanding
motivation: Dense frame encoding导致长视频MLLM计算代价过高、内存消耗大、可扩展性差
problem_framing: 将视频理解从exhaustive process-then-reason重构为query-guided reason-then-perceive范式
key_insight: Saliency与relevance不同，视觉显著区域未必与查询相关；LLM应控制感知时机与位置
method_signature: 四组件迭代循环：RTP生成时序计划→Perception选择性获取→TCR时序一致性校验→TM跨迭代图记忆
evaluation_criteria: 多基准准确率与评分，并关注frame消耗比例衡量效率-效果权衡
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 框架性能受制于底层LLM推理质量，且non-obvious查询存在cold start问题
evidence_for_taste: saliency and relevance are not synonymous
visually prominent segments may be irrelevant to the query
bridging the gap between reasoning and temporal understanding
must a model process the entire visual stream
adaptive feedback loop between reasoning and perception
thinking_moves: 从信息论视角指出visual streams低时序熵与人脑过滤机制的不匹配，反问是否必须处理全部视觉流
将perception问题重新框定为communication问题——让LLM通过符号推理指导视觉采样时机
把时序理解挑战表述为bridging symbolic reasoning与continuous time的语义鸿沟问题
从人类认知的attentional机制汲取灵感，将query意图作为perceptual resource分配的依据
通过ablation量化验证每组件的必要性，而非仅报告总体性能
